verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a home and business phone service, since phone systems such as PBXs can be deployed on-premises, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only a vendor-operated service: a cellular Base device, subscription plans, and a vendor-managed app and dashboard. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
